info.text: The company has decided to exclude tele-text from the remote control's functionality due to the internet's popularity.
The remote control will only be used to control the television, not the VCR, DVD, or other devices.
The company wants the corporate color and slogan to be implemented in the new design.
The corporate slogan is 'Putting the fashion in electronics'.
The group needs to decide on the target audience and market for the remote control.
The target audience is likely to be young and tech-savvy.
The remote control should be easy to use and have a unique design.
The group discusses the idea of incorporating speech recognition into the remote control.
The remote control will have the following functions: volume, channel, and skip to certain channels with numbers.
The group decides to focus on the TV control and not to consider VCR, DVD, or other devices.
The group considers the power source for the remote control and decides to use regular batteries.
The target audience is likely to be between 15 and 35 years old.

summary: The remote control will control only the TV, with functions for volume, channel, and numbered skip. It will have a unique, easy-to-use design with the corporate color and slogan 'Putting the fashion in electronics'. The target audience is young, tech-savvy, and 15-35 years old. Regular batteries will power the remote.
